title: A submitted game: packages/<id>/<version>.json
description: One file per game version, added by a pull request. The CI (tools/market_tool.py ci) downloads `source`, compares `sha256`, unzips it safely and runs tools/check.py; `manifest` must equal the zip's manifest.json.

thumb.description: Optional tile picture beside this file, at most 512 kB (512 x 288 PNG suggested).

notes.description: What changed in this version (for the reviewers).
